name: Stovetop Mac and Cheese
directions: Cook the macaroni in salted boiling water until al dente and drain. In the same pot, melt the butter over medium heat, whisk in the flour, and cook for 1 minute. Slowly whisk in the milk and cook, stirring, for 5 minutes until thickened. Remove from the heat and stir in the grated cheddar until melted and smooth. Add the macaroni, season with salt and pepper, and stir to coat.
